status: Native Classic RGB16 Gradient Map implemented; two one-working-level sample differences remain

candidate.source: Empirical observations from original procedural documents recalculated by Photoshop 2026; no Adobe implementation code copied
candidate.tone_coordinates: Use the separately qualified fixed-weight RGB16 coordinate rule from GRADIENT_MAP_TONE_REFERENCES.json.
candidate.nearest_bucket: center = ((n + 63) // 128) * 128; halfway ties select the lower bucket
candidate.expanded_stop_color: K = 256*n - center; K represents color scaled by 255
candidate.integer_midpoint: M = (segment_length * midpoint_percent + 50) // 100; rounds to nearest integer
candidate.piecewise_coordinate: offset*(0.5/M) when offset<=M, otherwise 0.5+(offset-M)/(segment_length-M)*0.5; preserve operation order.
candidate.cubic_coefficients: Left: (next_color - previous_color)/2. Right: (following_color - current_color)/2. Endpoint indices clamp to the first/last stop; stop distances do not rescale these coefficients.
candidate.smoothing: linear*(1-smoothness)+cubic*smoothness, clamped to segment endpoint values
candidate.rounding_limit: All prior 15 references now agree; new independent random/extreme-midpoint references expose two one-working-level positions. These remain measured failures of full parity.
candidate.arithmetic: Native Swift Double with exact integer-scaled color inputs; no Int128, epsilon or per-pixel exceptions.
candidate.midpoint_normalization: Clamp percent to 5...95 before rounding its segment location; Photoshop saves the clamped value.
candidate.boundary: At coincident positions, use the last color in stable stop order. Exact stops bypass interpolation.

failed_candidates.coarse_ramp_lookup: Intervals 2...64 do not explain the residuals.
failed_candidates.uniform_color_clamp_only: Removes 380-level overshoot but leaves rounding errors.
failed_candidates.double_operation_orders: 900 equivalent-operation variants did not resolve all linear boundary differences; best has five differing opaque pixels.
failed_candidates.int128: Swift typechecking rejects the required macOS14 deployment target; Int128 needs macOS15.

next: Resolve the two remaining floating-boundary positions using independent holdouts without data-specific exceptions.

Continue other gradient methods, Smooth, Gradient Fill/paint pixel qualification and the full professional-workflow backlog.
